title: Watch DhwaniTTS Official Setup Tutorial!
short_msg: Learn how to set up DhwaniTTS, download voices, use 4 Pro Modes & Language Toggles.
full_msg: Our official step-by-step tutorial for DhwaniTTS by ITFB is now live on YouTube! Watch it to learn how to install and configure DhwaniTTS as your default TTS engine, download Hindi and English voices, switch between the 4 Pro Engine Modes (Natural, Sonic, Crisp, and Turbo), use Real-Time Mix Language Toggles, and sync speech rate smoothly with TalkBack. Tap the link below to watch now!
